fact: Car 63 collided with car 6 in turn 6.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. On the entry to turn 6, car 6 was ahead and car 63 attempted to overtake. The stewards do not consider turns 5 and 6 to be part of a chicane therefore this incident is considered only on the situation on the approach to and exit from turn 6. Car 63 being on the inside, fails to satisfy the conditions for claiming the right to the corner as its front axle is not level with the mirror of Car 6. There being no mitigating circumstances, the baseline penalty is applied.
stewards: exit from turn 6. Car 63 being on the inside
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 63 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
